The present petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. against the order passed on application filed by the accused, under Section 91 Cr.P.C., for calling the CD of the conversation between the parties.
It is submitted that the said CD was confiscated during the investigation, but was no where considered in the final report, for the offence under Section 420 and 406 of IPC.
Furthermore, it is submitted that qua the said matter a negative Final Report was filed, stating that no offence has been constituted.

Upon a perusal of the order sheets, it is observed that the petition was filed in the year 2019, the same was listed on [2024:RJ-JP:29534] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-5492/2019] 27.04.2023, wherein, the Ramji Lal Sharma S/O Sh. sentences.text: Thereafter, on 12.04.2023, again an adjournment was sought.
Today, when the matter was called, none has marked appearance on behalf of the petitioner.
The status report in the instant case is unknown.
It appears that no sincere efforts are made by the petitioner, to contest the matter, ever since filing of the instant petition.
Considering the same, the instant petition is dismissed.
Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
(SAMEER JAIN),J ANIL SHARMA /56 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
